title: Hotdog Ori Scene
description: Replaces the Pigscene Painting with one that instead shows Hotdog Ori from Wolfmaxxing
body:
Hey Wolfmaxxing fans have you ever wanted a painting of the Hottest Dog? Well now you can.

This resource pack replaces the PigScene painting with one that depicts Ori's delicious hotdog form.
It also changed the name to HotdogScene (+ and adds my name to the credits) when you have a painting forced to be it

If you use the Vanilla Tweaks pack to add custom icons for pre-set paintings this also changes the icon for this painting to show hotdog ori.
